//: NOT currently consulted by anything. This file's original purpose: provide .dependency-cruiser.cjs's `tsConfig` option a way to resolve `@coderlix/*` workspace-package import specifiers down to source files, so the dependency-boundary check would work on import statements even before any package.json declares a real `workspace:*` dependency. That `tsConfig` reference was removed from .dependency-cruiser.cjs after a real run showed it caused dependency-cruiser to report '0 modules, 0 dependencies cruised' -- i.e. it silently stopped scanning any production file at all. This file is left in place, unused, because the underlying need (resolving @coderlix/* aliases for the boundary check) will return once a later step adds a real cross-package import using that syntax -- see .dependency-cruiser.cjs's options comment for the full diagnostic history and the forward-looking caveat. This file is NOT extended by any package's own tsconfig.json and is NOT used for `tsc -b` / `pnpm -r build`; each package continues to build in isolation per its own tsconfig.json.
